export function slugify(input: string): string {
  return input
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-')       // collapse whitespace to single hyphens
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '') // strip characters outside [a-z0-9-]
    .replace(/-+/g, '-')        // collapse multiple hyphens
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');      // strip leading/trailing hyphens
}

I’ll move the test output to a .js file using Node transpiler (tsc) so the demo works as requested.Often, Node types and tests are compiled first.
